additional_info.subject: 0450708 - ID0450708-DC/Si-D/AR-[MP / P7 170000780]Charger does not connect to SCB CRM:00263000090
additional_info.body:
Hello,
We have checked the charger and we found the root cause, you need to flash CFAST Card and restore the configuration, it's needed someone to go onsite.
We recommend you to use the companion tool to flash the CFAST Card:
How to Restore configuration:
https://wiki.siemens.com/pages/viewpage.action?spaceKey=en&title=3+-+Live+Linux+Userscripts
7. Copy the "restore-config" to the script_to_run folder and delete the others
You need to have a Siemens access to flash the CFAST via Companion Tool
Please find attached the files for the configuration, please use the version 4.0.11 since it's the last used.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that this product is no longer under warranty, as a result, we are only able to support the topic for 1 hour. After that it is necessary to order support from us. Please let me know if you would like to order support for this topic, so I can prepare an offer. You can also reach out to Rui Teodoso (
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
) or Afonso Sousa (
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
).
In case it's not needed support, let me know and we can close the ticket, if you prefer to have the ticket in your side to follow up just let me know. Thank you!
With best regards,
Guilherme Andre De Verissimo Dias
Siemens S.A.
SI E CS SD L3
201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547, Corroios, Portugal
